description:
Join a dedicated team at a premier health and rehabilitation center in Gainesville, FL, as a Full-time Speech-Language Pathologist (SLP). You will collaborate with an interdisciplinary team to develop individualized treatment plans, ensuring a holistic approach to patient recovery and well-being. This full-time position provides a stable schedule and the chance to make a significant impact on the lives of our residents.

Current and valid Speech-Language Pathologist license in Florida
Certificate of Clinical Competence (CCC) from ASHA
Prior experience in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation setting preferred
salaryOrBonusInfo: Hourly rate of $40.00 - $52.00 based on experience.
